svg.title: Image download: retries, give-up and redelivery

g.text: Image download: retries, give-up and redelivery
[image is no longer pending (duplicate or redelivered message)]
(an earlier delivery may have died before this)
too large, bad URL, redirect loop]
body deadline, time limit) or unexpected (bug, disk full)]
Every write is idempotent: image IDs are uuid5(feed_id, url),
status changes only WHERE status = pending, and the feed
becomes done only when it is parsed and no image is pending.
A worker killed at any point is safe: RabbitMQ redelivers
